transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I’m Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
Um… mostly my sleep. It’s been really off lately. I’m either up half the night with my mind going, or I wake up way too early and still feel like I didn’t really sleep.
Do you have trouble falling asleep at night, or does your mind stay very active even when you’re trying to sleep?
Yeah… it does. I’ll be trying to sleep, but my mind just keeps going, and then I’m up half the night. Or I wake up really early and don’t feel rested at all.
When you have trouble sleeping, does it usually happen when you're first trying to fall asleep, or do you wake up in the middle of the night or too early in the morning?
It’s kind of both. Sometimes I can’t fall asleep because my mind keeps running, and other times I wake up way too early and feel like I didn’t really rest.

Do you feel that your sleep problems are mainly due to things like feeling down, losing interest in things, or other emotional issues, or do they seem to happen even when you're feeling okay emotionally?
I’m not totally sure… it mostly just feels like my sleep is messed up. Like my mind keeps running and I’m up half the night, or I wake up too early and don’t feel rested.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot or feeling anxious, especially around the time you're trying to sleep?
I don’t know… I mean, I think about things, but I wouldn’t say I notice it as like, worrying a lot. It’s more just my head won’t quiet down.
Do you often feel like your sleep isn’t restful, even if you’ve slept for a decent amount of time?
Yeah… even if I’m technically asleep for a while, I’ll wake up feeling like I didn’t really rest. It’s like my sleep just isn’t… good.
Outside of your sleep issues, have you noticed any days where you felt down, hopeless, or lost interest in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah… some days I do. I’ll wake up with this heavy, empty feeling, and it’s kind of embarrassing, but even sitting in my own condo—something I worked really hard for—can make me feel like I might cry.
How often do you feel down or lose interest in things—does this happen most days, or is it more occasional?

It’s… not every single day, I don’t think. But it’s been happening enough lately that I notice it. I’ll wake up feeling really heavy and empty, and even being in my condo can make me feel like I’m about to cry.
Do these feelings of feeling heavy, empty, or like you might cry happen nearly every day, or are they more spread out with some days being better than others?

More spread out, I think. Some days are better… but lately I do wake up with that heavy, empty feeling, and it can hit me even just sitting in my condo. Like I worked so hard for it, and I still feel like I might cry.
Do these feelings of heaviness, emptiness, or being close to tears happen on most days, or do they come and go with several days in between?

It comes and goes… but lately it’s been there a lot when I wake up. That heavy, empty feeling. Sometimes I’m just sitting in my condo and I feel like I could cry, which feels stupid to say, because I worked so hard for it.
Do you feel down, heavy, or empty on most days, or are there several days in between when you feel more like yourself?
Most days lately, I guess. I keep waking up with that heavy, empty feeling… and even sitting in my condo can make me feel like I’m about to cry.
Do you feel down, heavy, or empty most of the day, nearly every day, or do these feelings come and go throughout the day?
It’s… mostly when I wake up lately, and it can hang around. It’s that heavy, empty feeling. Sometimes even just sitting in my condo makes me feel like I might cry.
Do you feel down, heavy, or empty for most of the day, nearly every day, or do these feelings come and go with periods of feeling better in between?
It’s there a lot lately… especially when I wake up. It can ease up some, but that heavy, empty feeling keeps coming back. Even sitting in my condo, I’ll feel like I might cry.
Do you feel down, heavy, or empty for most of the day, nearly every day, or do these feelings come and go with periods of feeling better in between?
It’s mostly there when I wake up… that heavy, empty feeling. It can come and go some, but lately even just sitting in my condo makes me feel like I’m going to cry.
Have you noticed that things you used to enjoy, like hobbies or activities, don’t seem to bring you the same pleasure lately?
Yeah… I guess so. I stopped going to salsa class, and my paints are still sitting out on the table, but I just look at them and… nothing. Like they’re somebody else’s things.
Have you noticed a loss of energy or feel fatigued a lot of the time, even when you haven't done much physically?
Yeah… I mean, even if I’ve been in bed all night, I still feel wiped out. Just getting from the parking lot into work feels… heavier than it should. By lunch my head feels kind of used up.
Do you feel down, heavy, or empty for most of the day, nearly every day, or do these feelings come and go with periods of feeling better in between?
I know I kind of said it already, but… yeah. Lately I wake up with that heavy, empty feeling. It’s there most of the day, and even being in my own condo just makes me feel like I might cry.
Would you say that your feeling of heaviness or emptiness is present nearly every day for most of the day, or are there significant parts of the day when you don’t feel this way?
Most of the day, yeah. I kind of wake up with it already there… that heavy, empty feeling. Even just sitting in my condo, it hits me, like I could cry for no real reason.

Would you say that your feeling of heaviness or emptiness is present nearly every day for most of the day, without much relief, or are there significant parts of the day when you don’t feel this way at all?
It’s… pretty much there most days. I wake up already feeling heavy and empty, and even just being in my condo can make me feel like I’m about to cry. There isn’t much relief lately.
